rows.jp: 桜庭がカレーパンを食っていた。
こいつは簡単だ。ちょろい。
rows.en: He would be easy. Child’s play.

rows.jp: 日曜の時点で身柄を押さえていればいいだろう。
rows.en: All I needed was to have him in custody by Sunday.

ghs.en: I should just secure the suspect until that point in time on Sunday.
Taichi: "On Sunday morning, rendez-vous at my house."
Sakuraba: "Got that. Leave it to me."

rows.en: He was not to be trusted. Obviously.

ghs.en: I can't give him my trust. Of course.

rows.jp: 陽光が窓を貫いていた。

ghs.en: Sunlight was piercing through the window.

rows.jp: 熟睡していたらしい。夢一つ見なかった。
rows.en: I must have slept soundly. I didn’t dream at all.

ghs.en: Seems I have been hard asleep. I did not have any dreams.

rows.en: I had to get to school.

ghs.en: I handed him a surgical mask.

rows.jp: 何の疑問も持たずにつけた。
rows.en: He put it on without question.

ghs.en: He put it on, not one doubt or question.

rows.jp: 「一時間目の授業に備えている」
「……カレーパンを食うのが授業なのか」
rows.en: “...Eating curry bread is a class now?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...is the subject curry bread perhaps?"

rows.jp: 「カレーパンがなくなるその日まで」
rows.en: “Until the day the curry bread runs out.”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "Until that day when curry bread itself has finally passed."

rows.jp: 「レトルトのカレーでも食ってればいいじゃないか」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Wouldn't you like to eat some retort pouch curry too?"
ghs.assessment: Taichi dismissively says that Sakuraba could just eat packaged curry. The English turns this into a polite offer or preference question and adds 'too.'
ghs.remedy: You could just eat some packaged curry.

highlights.text: Wouldn't you like to eat some retort pouch curry too?

rows.jp: 記録はどんどん成就していく。
rows.en: Everything in the record kept coming true.

ghs.en: The records are, more and more, steadily being fulfilled.
Taichi: "...whew, there it goes, the Tragedy of the Hexagon."

rows.en: That, too, was in the record.

rows.jp: 発生率は、今まで確認しただけでも、１５％以上。
rows.en: From what I’d seen so far, it happened at least fifteen percent of the time.

ghs.en: Rate of occurrence, up to present, has been just confirmed to be 15% or more.

rows.jp: 七回に一度は、鼻汁橋をぶち込まれる計算だ。
rows.en: By that reckoning, I’d get hit with a bridge of snot once in every seven.

ghs.en: My calculations say that once in seven times I will be struck with a Nasal Discharge Bridge.

rows.jp: だが過去の偉い人（俺）は、マスクを装着させることで回避する術を編み出したのだ。
rows.en: But the great man of ages past—me—had devised a means of prevention: make him wear a mask.

ghs.en: However, a celebrated personage of the past (I) has worked out the technique of avoidance of such via installation of a mask, indeed.
Sakuraba: "...is it OK if I take off the mask?"
Taichi: "Well, I'll be going home now."

rows.jp: 「日曜日朝に俺の家に集合だぞ」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Rendez-vous at my house on Sunday morning, got that!"

rows.en: As if I could trust him.

ghs.en: Yeah, because I can trust you.

rows.jp: 脱走させないための門。
rows.en: The gates were designed to keep students from escaping.

rows.jp: 学生を守っているというより、外の世界を、俺たちから守っているような。
rows.en: They seemed less like protection for the students than protection for the outside world from us.

ghs.en: It seems to exist less to protect students, and more to protect the outside world from us.

rows.jp: そんな印象を抱かせた。
rows.en: That was the impression they gave.

ghs.en: That is the impression it left.

rows.jp: 「倦怠感に包まれた貴様に一つ言っておくが」
rows.en: “One warning for a man sunk in ennui.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Let me tell ya one thing, you apathetic lassitude-filled bastard."

rows.en: “Don’t go off on a journey without my say-so.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Don't you up and decide to go on a trip or something!"

rows.jp: 「その安請け合いが不安なんだ！　聞こえてるのか！」
rows.en: “You agree so easily it makes me nervous! Are you even listening!?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "That agreement's so quick that it makes me uneasy! Are you even listening?!"

rows.jp: 「平気だ。おまえの許可を取ればいいんだろ？」
rows.en: “It’s fine. I just need your permission, right?”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "It's alright. If I get your permission it's OK, right?"

ghs.assessment: Taichi positively acknowledges that Sakuraba does understand. The English changes this into a negative question suggesting that he failed to understand.

rows.en: “Does an adventure count as a journey?”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "All of that then... explorations too then."

rows.jp: 「この街を出ようとする行為全般をさす」
rows.en: “Any attempt whatsoever to leave this town counts.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "All acts and conducts in general that get you out of this town."

rows.jp: 「なあ、一つ疑問があるんだが」

rows.en: “You know the kanji for ‘torment’—the one with a woman between two men?”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "That kanji with two men surrounding one woman that somehow only means "to tease" (3P-style),"

rows.en: “...Says the guy who can’t get it up.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...but yer impotent, you son of a bitch."
Taichi: "What is it now, what is it!"

rows.en: “I’ve decided to go on a journey!”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "Turns out I'm going on a trip!"

rows.en: I chopped him across the back of the neck.

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "So from next week I can?"

rows.jp: 「ああ。来週からはＯＫだ。あと数日の辛抱だ」
rows.en: “Yes. Next week is fine. Just hold out a few more days.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Yah. From next week it's okieh. Endure for a few days more."

rows.jp: 「唐突なやつだ。昨日の今日で」
rows.en: “Just like that? We only talked about this yesterday!”

ghs.en: Taichi: "That was a sudden one. Just from yesterday to today."
Sakuraba: "I got sick of curry bread."

rows.jp: 「刺激が足りなくなった。なにか面白いものを探しに行く」
rows.en: “It isn’t stimulating enough anymore. I’m going to look for something interesting.”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "The stimulus is no longer enough. I wanna go searching for something interesting."

rows.jp: 「おまえには妖精の血が流れている気がする」
rows.en: “I swear you have fairy blood in your veins.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Feels like you got fairy blood in your veins."

rows.jp: 「それにもしかしたら人と会えるかも知れない」
rows.en: “Besides, I might meet someone out there.”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "Besides it could even be that I'll meet people there."

rows.jp: 考えてないわけじゃないのか。
rows.en: So there was some thought behind it.

ghs.en: That just means he hasn't thought through this at all, doesn't it.
ghs.assessment: The Japanese double-negative question concludes that Sakuraba has given the matter some thought. The English removes that negation and concludes the opposite.
ghs.remedy: he has given this some thought

highlights.text: he hasn't thought through this at all

rows.jp: 「そうそう、借りていた金も返そうと思ってな」
rows.en: “Oh, and I mean to repay the money I borrowed.”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "Right, right, and I thought I'd give you back the money you lent me."

rows.en: “Right. I think I did lend you some...”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Yeah, I did have to lend you some..."

rows.jp: もう金なんて意味ないのにな。
rows.en: Money no longer meant anything anyway.

ghs.en: Even if money's meaningless now, really.

rows.jp: 「さあ、金額は記憶してないなぁ」
rows.en: “No idea. I don’t remember the amount.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Dunno, I have nooo memory of how much."

rows.jp: 「とりあえず小銭入れごと渡そう」
rows.en: “Then take the whole coin purse for now.”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "For now I'm handing over my coin purse."

rows.jp: 「あと足りない分はこれで補ってくれ」

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "And, I'll be supplementing the amount that's missing with this."
ghs.assessment: Sakuraba hands something to Taichi and tells him to use it to make up the shortfall. The English instead says that Sakuraba himself will do the supplementing.
ghs.remedy: Use this to make up whatever you're short.

highlights.text: I'll be supplementing the amount that's missing with this.

rows.jp: 荷物から木箱を取り出す。
rows.en: He pulled a wooden box from his luggage.

ghs.en: He takes out a wooden box from the bag.

rows.jp: 「あ、それはいい……持ち帰ってくれ」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Ah, we're good with that... take it back home."

rows.jp: 「そうか？　金になると思うが」
rows.en: “You sure? I think it’s worth money.”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "You sure? I think this is worth money."

rows.jp: 「してはいけない。どっかの博物館に寄付しなければだめだ」
rows.en: “Don’t sell it. Donate it to a museum.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Yes, but that's not happening. And it's out of the question not to donate that to some museum."

rows.jp: 「なあ、来週の旅のことなんだが」

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "Say, about that trip next week."
Sakuraba: "Won't you come together with me?"

rows.jp: 「まあスズメでもトンビにでもなってくれ」
rows.en: “You can become a sparrow or a kite for all I care.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Well, we're more like Tree Sparrow (those chatty ones) and Black Kite."
ghs.assessment: Taichi dismissively tells Sakuraba that he can become a sparrow or kite for all Taichi cares. The English instead assigns both birds to the pair, adds a species gloss, and presents it as Taichi's comparison.
ghs.remedy: Fine, become a sparrow or a kite for all I care.

highlights.text: Well, we're more like Tree Sparrow (those chatty ones) and Black Kite.

rows.jp: 「じゃあ、俺はそろそろ旅に出ることにする」
rows.en: “Then I suppose it’s time I set out.”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "Well, about time I get to go on my trip."

rows.jp: 「日曜までいろと言っただろうが！」
rows.en: “I told you to stay until Sunday!”

ghs.en: Taichi: "I told to be here until Sunday didn't I!"
ghs.assessment: The English omits the object of 'told.' Taichi says that he told Sakuraba to remain through Sunday.
ghs.remedy: I told you to be here until Sunday

highlights.text: I told to be here until Sunday

ghs.en: Taichi: "Arrested on the spot, no warrant."

rows.jp: 「そうだ。そんで日曜までここで暮らせ」
rows.en: “Yes. And you’re staying here until Sunday.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Indeed. And so, you will be living here until Sunday."

rows.jp: 「そしたらおまえに、哀れなる桜庭という二つ名をつけてやる」
rows.en: “Do that, and I’ll grant you the title Sakuraba the Pitiful.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Also, I'll give you the second name of Pitiable Sakuraba."

rows.jp: 「マジか。格好良すぎじゃないか。決まりだな」
rows.en: “Seriously? That’s too cool for words. Done.”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "You serious? Ain't that way too cool. It's decided."
Taichi: "You eat after you get over there."

rows.jp: 「ずいぶんとムサいピクニックだな」

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "It's a very squalid picnic, innit."

rows.jp: 「うむ。まさにそういうコンセプトだ」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Yup! Indeed the concept's like that."

rows.en: “Next week, I'm going on a journey.”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "Next week, I'm going on a trip."

rows.jp: 桜庭をその場所に連れて行く。
rows.en: I led Sakuraba to the spot.

ghs.en: I brought Sakuraba to that place.

rows.jp: 「良い目安になるでしょうっと」
rows.en: “It ought to make a good marker.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...and, walk straight on from here."

rows.jp: 「ああ、それでいい。まっすぐな……そこでストップ」
rows.en: “Yes, that's good. Straight ahead... Stop there.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Yeah, that's fine. Straight forwards... and stopp' there."

rows.jp: さて、あと数分もないだろう。
rows.en: There could only be a few minutes left.

ghs.en: Well then, it won't be for a few more minutes I guess.
We made it at just at the last moment, didn't we.

rows.jp: 「どうして、こういうことをするんだ？」
「どうしてって、別に意味はない」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Why, well it doesn't have much of a meaning."

rows.jp: 「そういう目をしているからな」
rows.en: “I can see it in your eyes.”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "Because you have those eyes, that's why."

rows.jp: 「オレたちは親友じゃないか」

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "Aren't the two of us buddies?"

rows.jp: 何言ってるんだコイツは！
rows.en: What the hell was he talking about?!

ghs.en: I was at loss for words.

rows.en: This was the twenty-first century, for God's sake.

rows.jp: 「つるむのは、もうおしまいなのか？」
rows.en: “So this is it? We're not hanging out anymore?”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "We're now all done with our mate-ing, right?"

rows.jp: 「おまえがオレを嫌うのなら、仕方ないけどな」
rows.en: “If you don’t like me, I guess there’s nothing I can do.”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "If you got to hate me, then nothing I can do, ya know."

rows.en: “...No, Sakuraba. That's not what this means.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...no, Sakuraba. That's not what it means."

rows.jp: 「おかしなことばかりおこるな、ここ最近は」
rows.en: “A lot of strange things have been happening lately.”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "Been just lots of weird things happening on these last few days."

rows.en: I had to send him back.

rows.jp: この馬鹿の顔を、二度と見なくなる―――
rows.en: I would never see this idiot's face again—

ghs.en: to never see this idiot's face ever again---

rows.jp: ただそれだけのことなのに。

ghs.en: Even if it's just that and nothing else.

rows.jp: 「けど一番ショックなことは、おまえが追いつめられているのに、何もできないことだ」
rows.en: “But the worst part is knowing you're cornered and not being able to do a thing for you.”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "But the most shocking thing was, even though you were cornered, you couldn't do anything about it."
ghs.assessment: Sakuraba says that his own inability to do anything while Taichi was cornered shocked him most. The English makes Taichi both the cornered person and the one unable to act.
ghs.remedy: even though you were cornered, I couldn't do anything about it

highlights.text: even though you were cornered, you couldn't do anything about it

rows.jp: 「おまえは自分のことだけ考えてろ。人の心配なんざ百年早いんだよ。桜庭の分際でシリアスなこと言ってんじゃない」
rows.en: “Just worry about yourself. Give it another hundred years before you try worrying about anyone else. And don’t start getting serious on me. You’re Sakuraba.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "You stick to thinking about your own self. Yer a century too young to to be worrying about people! Your social class is that of someone who can't say serious stuff, Sakuraba!"

rows.jp: 「……昔のおまえ、そんな感じだった」

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "...yourself from long ago felt just like that."

rows.jp: 「最近はずっと無理してるみたいだったからな」
rows.en: “Lately, it’s seemed like you’ve been forcing yourself.”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "'Cause recently you kept trying to overdo stuff."

rows.jp: こんな時に、思い出させて。
rows.en: Of all times to make me remember.

ghs.en: He made me remember it, right at this occasion.
Taichi: "...ya get out of here, you dumb son of a bitch."

rows.en: I closed my eyes, then opened them—

ghs.en: I closed my eyes, and on opening them---

ghs.assessment: Sakuraba wonders whether the sound is a broadcast. The English mistakes the noun for the unrelated passive action 'sent back.'

rows.jp: 桜庭という『ズレ』は正常に帰った。
rows.en: The ‘misalignment’ called Sakuraba had returned to normal.

ghs.en: The 'shift' called Sakuraba was returned back to normalcy.

rows.jp: 今時、そんなことを言うヤツがいるか。
rows.en: Who even says things like that anymore?

ghs.en: That there would exists a guy that would blurt out that right on this occasion.
ghs.assessment: The Japanese is a rhetorical question asking who would say such a thing nowadays. The English removes the negative rhetorical force, changes 'nowadays' to this particular occasion, and is grammatically malformed.
ghs.remedy: Who would say something like that nowadays?

highlights.text: That there would exists a guy that would blurt out that right on this occasion.

ghs.assessment: The Japanese is a negative rhetorical answer meaning that no such person exists. The English presents existence affirmatively and leaves an unattached fragment.

rows.jp: 笑いが止まらなかった。

rows.en: No matter how much I laughed—

rows.jp: 視界は滲むこともなかった―――

ghs.en: I'm glad of this, that's what.

rows.jp: もうあいつと会うこともない。
rows.en: I would never see him again.

ghs.en: Now I'll never see that guy again.

rows.jp: たくわえられた記憶が、俺にとっての桜庭のすべて。
rows.en: All I had of Sakuraba were the memories I’d stored away.

ghs.en: The memories that I have stored are everything that Sakuraba is to me.

rows.jp: 妙にこわくなって、震える膝を押さえる。
rows.en: A strange fear came over me. I pressed down on my trembling knees.

ghs.en: I became oddly afraid, so I hold down my shaking knees.

rows.jp: 顔を伏せて、目を閉じた。
rows.en: I bowed my head and closed my eyes.

ghs.en: I bowed down my head and closed my eyes.

rows.jp: まぶたを通じて、赤が侵略してきた。
rows.en: Red forced its way through my eyelids.

ghs.en: My eyelids conveyed the invasion of the red.

rows.jp: そしてまた、世界は巡る―――
rows.en: And once again, the world turned—

ghs.en: And once again the world went around---
